# KiCad sample files

Written by KiCad 7.0.11 itself (`kicad-cli`), so they are what KiCad writes:

- `R_0603.kicad_mod`: a footprint, saved by `kicad-cli fp upgrade --force`.
- `latch.kicad_sym`: a symbol library, saved by `kicad-cli sym upgrade --force` from OpenSchematix's KiCad export of
  its `start_stop_latch` example.

Used only to verify that RevisionWorx recognises genuine KiCad files by content.
